CheckTitle: Ensure S3 Buckets Do Not Use Predictable AWS Service Default Naming Patterns
Description: S3 buckets' names match predictable default naming patterns used by AWS services and toolkits (such as CloudFormation templates, AWS Glue assets, SageMaker, CodeStar, EMR, and AWS CDK default bootstrap qualifiers like 'hnb659fds').
Risk: Buckets following such naming conventions are vulnerable to shadow resource hijacking if uncreated or deleted across secondary regions. Furthermore, predictable names allow malicious actors to easily scan, discover, and target bucket resources across accounts.

Recommendation.Text: Avoid using default predictable S3 bucket naming patterns automatically generated by AWS services or toolkits (e.g., cf-templates-, aws-glue-assets-, sagemaker-, emr-, codestar-, or CDK's default 'hnb659fds' qualifier). Configure services to use unique, custom-named buckets with custom qualifiers to prevent shadow resource hijacking and targeted discovery.
